integrity: Both logarithmic inequality indices reduce at fixed household count and total to exact comparisons of integer products. Every positive integer partition through the sharp total is exhaustively enumerated, all pairwise comparisons are exact, and the complete first reversal layer is replayed by the embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: The cutoff is for strictly positive integer incomes compared at a common household count and common total. It is a finite-resolution boundary rather than an absolute monetary threshold for arbitrary real-valued income data. The checked record for the 1980 source supplied only issue-level dating, so the exact public-date anchor is the verified first-online date of the 2006 source.
title: Eleven income units are the sharp Theil-T–mean-log-deviation reversal boundary
